description.0: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

0.0: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <cryo>60</cryo> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by <cryo>16%</cryo> for 12s. The aforementioned effects can trigger even when the character is not on the field.
